cohort: The study included 1244 women and their newborns whose data were extracted from maternity registers at Rev. John Chilembwe Hospital.
finding: The prevalence of low birthweight was high (16.7%), and its significant predictors were prematurity, preeclampsia, antepartum hemorrhage, and sepsis.
cross-section timing: Data extracted from October, 2022 to March, 2023.
gest_age: Includes preterm, term, and postterm infants.
